classification.difficultyReason: Requires calculator reference angles, quadrant selection, reciprocal rearrangements and rounding all solutions to the nearest minute.

content.prompt: Solve the following for $0^{\circ}\leq\theta\leq360^{\circ}$, correct to the nearest minute.

answer.worked:
The related angle is $\alpha=\sin^{-1}\!\left(\frac13\right)\approx19.47122063^{\circ}$. Sine is positive in quadrants 1 and 2. Using the unrounded value of $\alpha$:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=\alpha,\ 180^{\circ}-\alpha\\\theta&\approx19^{\circ}28',\ 160^{\circ}32'\end{align*}$$

The related angle is $\alpha=\cos^{-1}(0.7)\approx45.57299600^{\circ}$. Cosine is negative in quadrants 2 and 3. Using the unrounded value of $\alpha$:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}-\alpha,\ 180^{\circ}+\alpha\\\theta&\approx134^{\circ}26',\ 225^{\circ}34'\end{align*}$$

Since $\cot\theta=\frac{\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}$ is nonzero here, both $\sin\theta$ and $\cos\theta$ are nonzero, so taking the reciprocal is valid.
$$\tan\theta=\frac{1}{2.74}$$
The related angle is $\alpha=\tan^{-1}\!\left(\frac{1}{2.74}\right)\approx20.05023687^{\circ}$. Tangent is positive in quadrants 1 and 3. Using the unrounded value of $\alpha$:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=\alpha,\ \alpha+180^{\circ}\\\theta&\approx20^{\circ}3',\ 200^{\circ}3'\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}5\cos\theta-2&=0\\5\cos\theta&=2\\\cos\theta&=\frac25\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $\alpha=\cos^{-1}\!\left(\frac25\right)\approx66.42182152^{\circ}$. Cosine is positive in quadrants 1 and 4. Using the unrounded value of $\alpha$:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=\alpha,\ 360^{\circ}-\alpha\\\theta&\approx66^{\circ}25',\ 293^{\circ}35'\end{align*}$$

$$\begin{align*}-3\operatorname{cosec}\theta&=4\\\operatorname{cosec}\theta&=-\frac43\\\sin\theta&=-\frac34\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $\alpha=\sin^{-1}\!\left(\frac34\right)\approx48.59037789^{\circ}$. Sine is negative in quadrants 3 and 4. Using the unrounded value of $\alpha$:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=180^{\circ}+\alpha,\ 360^{\circ}-\alpha\\\theta&\approx228^{\circ}35',\ 311^{\circ}25'\end{align*}$$

inlines.text: Check that dividing by cosine loses no solution, then solve

answer.worked:
If $\cos\theta=0$, then $\theta=90^{\circ}$ or $270^{\circ}$; neither satisfies the original equation. Division by $\cos\theta$ therefore loses no solution.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{2\sin\theta}{\cos\theta}&=5\\2\tan\theta&=5\\\tan\theta&=\frac52\end{align*}$$
The related angle is $\alpha=\tan^{-1}\!\left(\frac52\right)\approx68.19859051^{\circ}$. Tangent is positive in quadrants 1 and 3. Using the unrounded value of $\alpha$:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=\alpha,\ \alpha+180^{\circ}\\\theta&\approx68^{\circ}12',\ 248^{\circ}12'\end{align*}$$
